title: The headless child's SessionStart hooks (intake --file --hook, red-pipeline --hook) leave untracked drafts in the runner worktree, so its next restart is refused as dirty
goal: when KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set the intake and red-pipeline SessionStart hooks file nothing (or prepare_worktree ignores untracked kb/_self/backlog drafts), so a restarted sprint's worktree is clean and `runner reset` is not needed after every run; a planted-failure test runs the hook with the variable set and asserts nothing is written; found by the SP-itmjxudu review

run: import sys;t=open("_tools/bl_intake.py",encoding="utf-8").read();ok="KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER" in t;print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is that a SessionStart hook does not read the variable; the repro reads the hook's source for it
